jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java Backend
jobs.description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking for a Java backend developer with leadership experience who enjoys and thrives on solving complex problems through innovation while influencing change at scale in a diverse environment. You will technically lead a focused team of Automation Engineers introducing and advancing enterprise Automation practice through code across several hundred applications within EFT.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead moderately complex initiatives and deliverables within technical domain environments
* Contribute to large scale planning of strategies
* Design, code, test, debug, and document for projects and programs associated with technology domain, including upgrades and deployments
* Review moderately complex technical challenges that require an in\-depth evaluation of technologies and procedures
* Resolve moderately complex issues and lead a team to meet existing client needs or potential new clients needs while leveraging solid understanding of the function, policies, procedures, or compliance requirements
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and mid\-level managers to resolve technical challenges and achieve goals
* Lead projects and act as an escalation point, provide guidance and direction to less experienced staff

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Software Development: Java/ Python, SQL, bash or combination of other object oriented and scripting language(s)
* Automation: Ansible, Terraform, Amelia
* Java Full Stack – **JavaScript, Angular/React JS, SpringBoot, NodeJS, XML, HTML**
* Database: **Oracle, SQL, MongoDB**, Basic Data Modeling, PL/SQL
* OS and Platform: Azure, SQLMI, GCP, PCF, Kubernetes, **OpenShift,** Linux, Windows
* CI/CD: EPL/EPLX, **Harness**, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, SonarQube, Checkmarks, Blackduck, ServiceNOW AVR, Artifactory
* Observability and AIOPS: Grafana, Prometheus, Elastic, Kibana, AppDynamics, Splunk
* Track record of creating innovative and complex automation solutions, a combination of tooling and code.
* AI/ML, GenAI: Tachyon, NotebookLM, Microsoft co\-pilot, GitHub co\-pilot, LLM Models.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience presenting to senior leadership.
* Experience leading cross team initiatives.
* Hands on ability in designing and architecting complex end\-to\-end automation solutions requiring custom code and data integration patterns.
* 4\+ years of building automation solutions through tooling and code
* 4\+ years of Data Modeling and Data Integration Patterns
* 4\+ years of experience with logging, monitoring, and event detection on cloud or distributed platforms.
* 4\+ years of experience with one or more Technology Platforms (Cloud, o/s, etc.): Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF), Azure, GCP, Linux, Windows.
* Ability to work in a hybrid office environment.
* Flexible work timings and willing to work on shifts 16x7\.
* Ability to work outside of regular business hours, as needed.

**Job Expectations:**

* Instantiate Site Reliability Engineering practice at Wells Fargo EFT igniting the practice, principles, and culture leading by example. Assist in training skilled peer engineers by growing the practice within EFT and partnering with peer platform embedded SRE teams.
* Onboard critical customer journeys and applications to Site Reliability Engineering working within EFT and Lines of Business to assess the availability of critical business flows, identify service level objectives and indicators, instrument applications for observability, onboard to CI/CD pipeline taking advantage of continuous testing, introduce continuous inspection, continuous improvement, and conduct destructive testing to reach 99\.99% availability for the firms critical products and services leading to higher customer satisfaction and customer experience.
* Introducing enterprise capabilities, tools, and innovation improving availability in a multi\-cloud ecosystem by evolving observability, monitoring, logging, CI/CD integration, continuous testing (performance, smoke, regression, functional, chaos) introduce continuous improvement, standardization/automation, capabilities to conduct destructive and resiliency testing.
* Evolve AIOPS, ChatOps, NoOps introducing self\-healing and autonomic capabilities solving complex operational and systemic issues with precision including building and training models, automating cognitive processes, leveraging Robotic Process Automation, Unified Communication, and AI/ML to improve availability of products we provide to customers.
* Automate key SRE metrics and IT Service Operations processes including customer impact, % availability of critical business flows, SLO/SLI adherence, error budget, automated incident process for IT Service Operations through data integrating with unified communications, alerting/notification systems, and evolving ChatOps to reduce time to recovery.
* Share support responsibilities for critical applications and customer journeys on boarded to SRE including remediation of issues through Agile, conduct blameless postmortems, root cause analysis and introduce continuous improvement solving problems once and for all with the goal of no repeats.
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in\-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering automation solutions that are long\-term, medium to large scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking.
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in\-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical automation enginee…

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner - Salesforce TPM
jobs.description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

 **Lead Product Owner – Salesforce TPM (CG Cloud)**


Location: Hyderabad, India


Employment Type: Full\-Time


Reports To: GTO Application / Portfolio Lead

**About the Role**


The TPM Product Owner is part of Mattel's Global Technology Organization (GTO) and serves as the strategic product owner for Salesforce Consumer Goods (CG) Cloud Trade Promotion Management (TPM) capabilities.


This role partners closely with Commercial, Sales, Revenue Growth Management (RGM), Finance, Customer Development, and Technology teams to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and maximize business value across the TPM platform.


The Product Owner is responsible for the long\-term product roadmap, backlog prioritization, release planning, stakeholder alignment, and continuous improvement of Salesforce TPM capabilities. This role works closely with Development, QA, Salesforce Tech Ops, Release Management, and Commercial Portfolio leadership to ensure solutions are delivered with quality, scalability, and operational readiness.


This is a senior leadership role requiring deep knowledge of Trade Promotion Management processes, enterprise application delivery, Agile product management, and commercial business operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Product Strategy \& Roadmap***

* Own the Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM product roadmap and long\-term product vision.
* Partner with Commercial leadership to align technology investments with business priorities.
* Define strategic product objectives that improve trade planning, execution, and financial performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve business processes through technology innovation and automation.
* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and emerging technologies to drive continuous product evolution.

***Product Ownership \& Backlog Management***

* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, operational priorities, technical dependencies, and risk.
* Define epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria for development teams.
* Balance strategic initiatives, production support, technical debt, compliance requirements, and operational improvements.
* Partner with Solution Delivery teams to ensure backlog readiness for sprint planning.
* Continuously refine priorities based on changing business needs.

***Commercial Process Leadership***


Serve as the technology product owner for capabilities including:

* Trade Promotion Planning
* Customer Planning
* Key Account Management (KAM)
* Promotion Execution
* Trade Fund Management
* Claims Management
* Settlement \& Financial Reconciliation
* Promotion Effectiveness
* Retail Execution
* Customer Performance Analytics
* Reporting and Dashboards


Partner with business stakeholders to optimize commercial processes and improve user adoption across these capabilities.

**Release Planning \& Delivery**

* Participate in portfolio planning and release planning activities.
* Define business priorities for upcoming releases.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Ensure business readiness before production deployments.
* Participate in release validation and hypercare activities.
* Approve completed features prior to production deployment.

**Operational Excellence**

**Partner with the Salesforce Tech Ops team to:**

* Prioritize production issues.
* Review root cause analyses.
* Drive continuous platform improvements.
* Improve operational KPIs.
* Optimize platform adoption.
* Enhance business processes through automation.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary technology liaison for TPM capabilities.
* Facilitate roadmap reviews with executive leadership.
* Communicate release plans, priorities, and product strategy.
* Build consensus across multiple business functions.
* Drive adoption of new platform capabilities.

**Product Governance \& Continuous Improvement**

* Establish product governance practices.
* Measure product success through KPIs and business outcomes.
* Evaluate enhancement requests against strategic priorities.
* Drive continuous improvement across product management processes.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise governance and SOX requirements.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related field.
* **10\+ years** of experience supporting enterprise commercial applications.
* Minimum **5 years** serving as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or senior Business Systems Lead.
* Deep expertise in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and Trade Promotion Management.
* Strong understanding of commercial business processes including:
	+ Trade Promotion Management
	+ Revenue Growth Management
	+ Customer Planning
	+ Trade Funds
	+ Claims
	+ Promotion Execution
	+ Financial Settlement
* Experience managing Agile product backlogs and product roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and SAFe delivery methodologies.
* Experience working with globally distributed delivery teams.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive and senior business leaders.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale Salesforce implementations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Accredited Professional certification.
* Salesforce Administrator certification.
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner/Product Mana…

jobs.description:
Job requisition ID :: 109680
Date: Jul 29, 2026
Location: Hyderabad
Designation: Assistant Manager
Entity: Deloitte LLP  

**Role Title**: Assistant Manager \| Fullstack Java \| Hyderabad \| Engineering as a Service/ Operate


**Location:** Bangalore, Hybrid (3 days onsite, 2 days remote)


**Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP



About the Role


As a Full\-Stack Senior Product Software Engineer, you will collaborate with cross\-functional partners and engineering teams on the design and implementation of innovative products and features, contributing to the evolution of user\-centric advertising at scale. You’ll exercise technical ownership, provide peer mentoring, and ensure our systems are robust, observable, and future\-ready.


On a daily basis you should bring:


* A passion for building and owning mission\-critical systems. A growth mindset, with a willingness to mentor and learn in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
* A commitment and desire to effectively communicate and collaborate across teams and systems.
* An understanding of micro\-service encapsulation and loose coupling, and why they are important.
* An understanding of how to define technical and operational metrics to measure system health and to manage risk.
* A pragmatic approach to solving engineering challenges at scale.



Key Responsibilities:


* Design, build, and support scalable microservices and user interfaces for Disney’s Ad Platform, leveraging Java and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Collaborate with product, UX, and engineering peers to deliver features that enhance user\-centric advertising.
* Translate user stories into actionable engineering tasks with ownership from development through deployment.
* Mentor and support teammates through code reviews, documentation, and informal guidance (no direct reports).
* Improve system observability by implementing metrics, monitoring, and alerting solutions.
* Participate in on\-call rotations as part of our commitment to operational excellence.
* Champion best practices in code quality, automated testing, and agile workflows.
* Understanding and using automated tools (AI) while adhering to company policy


Required Qualifications / Must have:

  


* 9\-12 years of hands\-on software engineering experience.
* Proficiency with Java and related frameworks (Spring Boot, ORMs, etc..).
* Experience with ReactJS or modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Vue, Angular), and willingness to learn new technologies as needed.
* Strong background in relational databases (MySQL, Postgres), including schema and query design.


* Experience working with RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.


* Strong foundation in computer science principles, including data structures and algorithms.


* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications:


* Experience in ad tech.


* Experience with programmatic advertising or real\-time bidding platforms.


* Spring Boot and related Spring projects.


* Cloud platforms such as AWS.


* Modern DevOps tools such as Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes.


* Data Streaming Mechanisms such as Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, and/or SNS/SQS. Required Education

  



Preferred Qualifications / Good to Have:

  


* BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

**Job Title:** DEVELOPER L4
  
**City:** Hyderabad
  
**State/Province:** Telangana
  
**Posting Start Date:** 7/11/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Network Operations \- Utilities .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Manager, Mass Seller Engagement, SEG - USGS
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a builder who thrives at the intersection of sales, data, and Generative AI? Do you enjoy the challenge of taking a manual process and then building the tools to automate it on a WW scale?  

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Sales Manager with 8\+ years of relevant experience to drive a high\-impact global initiative: helping US\-based sellers expand their selection to reach Amazon's 19\+ international marketplaces worldwide (WW). In this role, you will lead our "one\-to\-many" seller engagement strategy, its implementation, and delivery of expected input and output results. You will leverage existing seller data and build/use Gen AI tools to create personalized, automated nudges across the seller's global expansion journey to drive US to WW selection expansion. You will leverage Gen AI tools to engage with thousands of new and existing Amazon Sellers and help them grow their business on WW global marketplaces.  

The ideal candidate is willing to roll up their sleeves to do the manual work of mass seller outreach today, while simultaneously partnering with product and program teams to develop the Gen AI tools of tomorrow to fully automate the seller engagement and outreach process. You are a leader who can manage trade\-offs between what is required to deliver today's results while thinking long term and building tools to scale your impact to WW global selling organizations.  

The ideal candidate will have strong sales, automation, and program management skills. They have experience leading mass seller engagement initiatives and proven experience driving global programs. Success in this role requires strong ownership, dive\-deep, invent and simplify, and think big skills. They are exceptional at stakeholder management, including the ability to influence without authority, drive alignment, and communicate effectively with senior leadership. This position offers the opportunity to shape the global selling experience for millions of Amazon sellers by developing innovative Gen AI solutions for mass seller engagement.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Key job responsibilities  

Drive mass seller engagement at scale:  

* Build and manage a fully automated mass seller engagement solution/agent by leveraging seller data and existing mass reach\-out tools for US to WW expansion and post\-launch growth.
* Customize seller messaging based on sellers' current stage in the global expansion funnel and/or performance on new global marketplaces.
* Measure impact of seller reach\-outs and adapt seller engagement to drive higher open rates and action rates.
* Adapt seller communication across different engagement channels to maximize open and action rates.
* Deliver expected input and output goals of seller launches and global sales GMS.
* Propose and lead ideation on enhancing seller engagement strategies with focus on conversion and post\-launch growth.
* Contribute to 3 year business growth plans and lead/contribute to other XBR meetings with senior leadership


Automate mass seller engagement:  

* Partner with sellers and seller\-facing teams to identify seller pain points in global expansion processes.
* Pilot and test new mass seller engagement models to drive US to WW expansion.
* Partner with product and program teams and own end\-to\-end development of Gen AI solutions for personalized mass seller engagement.
* Leverage custom\-built Gen AI tools to drive exponential growth initiatives for US to WW expansion and post\-launch seller growth.


Cross\-functional stakeholder management:  

* Own collaboration between product and program teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.
* Dive deep and represent key findings and recommendations to the senior leadership team for decision and action.
* Drive effective communication of mass seller engagement strategy, roadmap, and impact analysis to senior leadership.
* Drive US to WW expansion initiatives by collaborating with stakeholders across geographies and teams.
* Lead periodic review with senior regional leadership.

  

About the team  

This role partners with US Global Selling (USGS) team which owns the full business lifecycle of North American sellers expanding into Amazon’s 19 global marketplaces. Its mission is to make US marketplace selection accessible and affordable to Amazon customers worldwide. While US sellers excel on Amazon.com, it is just the beginning of their potential global expansion journey. USGS team is dedicated to simplifying global expansion and international selling for US sellers, working closely with Sellers on both tech and non\-tech aspects of product, supply chain and compliance. Amazon Global Selling team's vision is to be the first choice for all US retail businesses to go global. We operate with the agility of a startup and a singular mission: to empower US sellers to expand their business worldwide.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of sales experience
* Experience driving the sales management process as well as playing a hands\-on role in driving sales
* Experience closing sales and generating revenue
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience in a highly agile environment
* 6\+ years of partnering with cross functional teams experience
* Experience partnering with product and program management teams
* Experience delivering results by partnering with and influencing others

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience personally closing large complex deals end\-to\-end
* Experience developing and executing sales strategies, tactics, plans, processes, systems and programs
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience influencing C\-level executives
* Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree or above in engineering, mana…

jobs.title: Sr Product Owner [T500-27956]
jobs.description:
**About T\-Mobile:** 




 T\-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS) is America’s supercharged Un\-carrier, powered by an award\-winning 5G network that connects more people in more places than ever before. With its unique value proposition of best network, best value, and best experiences, T\-Mobile is redefining connectivity, fueling competition, and driving the next wave of innovation in wireless and beyond. Headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, T\-Mobile provides services through its subsidiaries and operates its flagship brands, T\-Mobile, Metro by T\-Mobile, and Mint Mobile.
 



  





**TMUS Global Solutions:** 




 TMUS Global Solutions is a world\-class technology organization accelerating T\-Mobile’s global digital transformation. Our teams combine engineering talent, technology expertise, and collaborative ways of working to build secure, scalable solutions that improve customer and employee experiences. We foster innovation, agility, transparency, and strong enterprise partnerships to deliver measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 The Senior Product Owner is accountable for backlog strategy, prioritization, and requirements definition for T\-Mobile’s offshore AI Platform \& Reliability Engineering organization. This role owns what gets built and in what order across AI platform capabilities, agent systems, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence investments. The role ensures engineering investments remain aligned with business priorities while balancing feature delivery, platform sustainability, operational excellence, and technical debt reduction.
 



 The Senior Product Owner serves as the product\-side decision\-maker for backlog prioritization, partnering closely with the Manager, Software Engineering \- AI Platform \& Reliability Engineering, who owns delivery execution, engineering operations, people leadership, and production reliability. The role reports to the Manager with a dotted\-line relationship to onshore Product Management to ensure alignment with strategic product direction.
 



 Success is measured through prioritization quality, roadmap alignment, backlog readiness, reduction of engineering rework, stakeholder alignment, and the team’s ability to consistently execute against business and platform objectives. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un\-carrier and making a tangible impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Own backlog strategy, prioritization, and sequencing across AI platform capabilities, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt, and operational excellence investments.
* Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into well\-defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are ready for engineering execution.
* Partner with engineering managers, architects, and technical leads to ensure backlog priorities align with platform architecture, engineering capacity, and business objectives.
* Balance competing priorities across feature delivery, platform sustainability, scalability, reliability, and technical debt while clearly communicating tradeoffs.
* Prioritize AI platform capabilities including agent orchestration, conversational platforms, SDKs, enterprise integrations, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)\-enabled capabilities.
* Ensure production readiness, operational excellence, and reliability engineering initiatives are appropriately represented within backlog priorities.
* Collaborate with onshore Product Management to align offshore engineering execution with product strategy and roadmap objectives.
* Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams, architects, Product Owners, and platform stakeholders to improve delivery predictability.
* Accept completed work against defined business and technical acceptance criteria.
* Use engineering metrics, operational insights, customer feedback, and platform health indicators to continuously refine backlog priorities and roadmap sequencing.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in Product Owner, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience owning prioritization decisions for complex engineering organizations supporting multiple workstreams and competing business priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in technically complex environments involving distributed systems, cloud\-native platforms, AI\-powered services, platform engineering, or reliability engineering.
* Proven experience managing backlogs that include feature delivery, platform investments, technical debt reduction, and reliability engineering work.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, microservices, data flows, and software delivery practices.
* Experience partnering with engineering managers, architects, and technical leads to balance roadmap objectives with platform sustainability and operational excellence.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Must Have Skills** 
 :
 


* Product ownership, backlog strategy, and prioritization
* Technical requirements definition and acceptance criteria
* Agile product delivery and sprint readiness
* Cloud\-native platforms, APIs, and distributed systems
* Stakeholder, dependency, and tradeoff management



  





**Nice\-to\-Have:** 



* Experience working with AI platforms, conversational AI systems, LLM\-powered services, or AI infrastructure.
* Experience working with SRE, platform engineering, or cloud operations teams.
* Familiarity with reliability engineering concepts, including SLOs, SLAs, observabil…

**Job TITLE**
 Product Owner
   

  

**General Summary**
 The Product Owner will have a technical focus and work with product managers, internal stakeholders, 3rd\-party partners, and customers to gain a thorough understanding of their product and market needs, translating them into feature stories and tasks for development. You will be responsible for turning the product vision into an actionable backlog and advocating the customers’ needs to the development team.
   

  

 The Product Owner is responsible for the development backlog, grooming, and acceptance. This individual will execute converting the product vision and roadmap into workable product requirements for engineering to meet product roadmap expectations defined by the Product Manager. This role will report to the Manager, Product Management – \[product line] and will regularly engage with cross\-functional leaders.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be well\-versed in agile scrum and comfortable working in all aspects of a multifaceted delivery network. You will demonstrate excellent problem\-solving skills, be self\-motivated and detail\-oriented, and be a good team player. Other duties include prioritization of key backlog items that drive growth and success, developing supporting documentation, and keeping customers and stakeholders informed of the status of the product.
   

  

**ROLES \& REPONSIBILITIES**
* Owns and prioritizes the sprint backlog for assigned platform and technical domains, balancing technical debt, reliability, and roadmap commitments
* Translates platform and technical requirements into well\-defined epics, user stories, technical specification and acceptance criteria
* Converts product vision into actional backlog items that deliver platform enablement, reliability, scalability and technical debt reduction
* Participates in sprint planning, grooming, retrospectives and reviews for assigned technical and platform teams
* Works with Product Management, Engineering leads, architects and security teams to support platform decisions that are technically sound and aligned with product direction
* Communicates platform capability needs to the development team and represents technical requirements in prioritization decisions
* Supports and utilizes technical discovery with Engineering leads and internal platform consumers to inform backlog priorities
* Communicates platform capability releases to internal consumers and Engineering teams in coordination with Product and Technology leadership
* Serves as a subject matter expert for assigned platform and technical domains, supporting Engineering onboarding tooling, and organizational education

* Participates in pod\-level planning, estimation sessions and steerco readouts as required

 KEY COMPETENCIES

* Customer first mind set
* Backlog execution – prioritizes and manages the spring backlog in alignment with the product roadmap defined by the Product Manager and/or Manager of Product Management
* Proactive, self\-starter with excellent project management skills and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment
* High degree of organization, individual initiative, and personal accountability
* Ability to assess risks, dependencies and propose mitigation strategies to overcome obstacles
* Skilled in leading meetings, setting agendas, driving decisions, and negotiating.


**REQUIRED Qualifications, EDUCATION, CERTIFICATES And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of professional experience, preferably in product ownership, project management or business analysis
* At least 1 year of experience in Product Management and/or Product Development
* Established background in launching software services in partnership with Engineering teams and high degree of proficiency in prototyping, iterative development and experience working within an Agile scrum team environment


**PREFERRED Qualifications**
* Experience in healthcare IT, supply chain, or SaaS environments
* Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, AI\-assisted product tools, and agile tooling

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Wealth Management
jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise\-wide implications.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data\-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource\-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go\-to\-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross\-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Product Management experience in Wealth Management, Financial Services, or Investment platforms
* Strong understanding of Wealth Management products, client journeys, and business processes
* Experience translating business needs into product capabilities and delivery requirements
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills across business and technology teams
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams including Engineering, UX, and Business stakeholders
* Customer\-centric mindset with ability to represent business needs and priorities
* Agile product delivery experience with roadmap and backlog management
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Experience managing priorities across multiple stakeholders and business functions
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across different time zones
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Experience with Digital Wealth Management or Client Portal platforms
* Knowledge of Micro Front\-End (MFE) architecture and modern digital product ecosystems
* Experience working on enterprise web platforms and customer\-facing applications
* Background in User Experience (UX) collaboration and design thinking
* Exposure to Secure Client Portals, Digital Self\-Service, or Advisor platforms
* Experience leading platform modernization or digital transformation initiatives


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

 Investment Data Foundations

* Review and approve data design artifacts to ensure clarity, correctness, and operational usability prior to production release.

* Partner with platform teams to ensure APIs integrate cleanly into the broader SAMDA ecosystem.
* Contribute to the development and standardization of shared API patterns and reusable components.


 Scalable Data Capabilities \& Platform Leverage
   

  

* Propose and design reusable data capabilities that address investment domain needs while scaling across the broader SAMDA platform.
* Identify patterns and abstractions from domain implementations that can be generalized and reused across multiple SAM data domains.
* Partner with Platform Engineering and Architecture to:


 oValidate scalability and reusability
   

  

 oAlign solutions with long term platform direction
   

  

 oAvoid domain specific point solutions where shared capabilities are appropriate
   

  

* Contribute domain driven enhancements back into shared data frameworks, models, and APIs.

 Platform Alignment, Security \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure all investment data and Data APIs comply with platform standards, data classification rules, information barriers, and governance expectations.

* Identify gaps in platform data or API capabilities and recommend improvements.

jobs.title: Sr Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.  

  

Mattel’s award\-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

  

Mattel is seeking a Senior Data Engineer or Senior ETL Developer, based out of our Technology \& Innovation Center in Hyderabad, India, reporting to the IT Director for Enterprise Data and Analytics.


This role will lead the design and development of scalable cloud\-based data pipelines using tools like BigQuery, Python, SQL, DBT, and Airflow. You will drive detailed designs decisions, ensure data quality, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver trusted, analytics\-ready datasets. This role also includes mentoring junior engineers and setting engineering best practices to support Mattel’s enterprise data strategy.

**What Your Impact Will Be:**

* Lead the development of scalable, secure, and high\-performing data integration pipelines for structured and semi\-structured data using Google BigQuery.
* Design and develop scalable data integration pipelines to ingest structured and semi\-structured data from enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, E\-commerce, Order Management) into a centralized cloud data warehouse using Google BigQuery.
* Build analytics\-ready pipelines that transform raw data into trusted, curated datasets for reporting, dashboards, and advanced analytics.
* Implement transformation logic using DBT to create modular, maintainable, and reusable data models that evolve with business needs.
* Apply BigQuery best practices—including partitioning, clustering, and query optimization—to ensure high performance and scalability.
* Automate and monitor complex data workflows using Airflow/Cloud Composer, ensuring dependable pipeline orchestration and job execution.
* Develop efficient, reusable Python and SQL code for data ingestion, transformation, validation, and performance tuning across the pipeline lifecycle.
* Establish robust data quality checks and testing strategies to validate both technical accuracy and alignment with business logic.
* Partner with architects and Technical leads to establish best practices, scalable frameworks, and reference implementations across projects.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including data analysts, BI developers, and product owners—to understand integration needs and deliver impactful, business\-aligned data solutions.
* Leverage modern ETL platforms such as Ascend.io, Databricks, Dataflow, or Fivetran to accelerate development and improve observability and orchestration.
* Contribute to technical documentation, CI/CD workflows, and monitoring processes to drive transparency, reliability, and continuous improvement across the data engineering ecosystem.
* Mentor junior engineers, conduct peer code reviews, and lead technical discussions.

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical field.
* Minimum 3**\+ years** of hands\-on experience in data engineering with strong expertise in data warehousing, pipeline development, and analytics on cloud platforms.
* Expert\-level experience in:
	+ **Google BigQuery** for large\-scale data warehousing and analytics.
	+ **Python** for data processing, orchestration, and scripting.
	+ **SQL** for data wrangling, transformation, and query optimization.
	+ **DBT** for developing modular and maintainable data transformation layers.
	+ **Airflow / Cloud Composer** for workflow orchestration and scheduling.
* Proven experience building enterprise\-grade ETL/ELT pipelines and scalable data architectures.
* Strong understanding of data quality frameworks, validation techniques, and governance processes.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and managing IT backlogs in a collaborative, iterative environment.
* Preferred experience with:
	+ Tools like **Ascend.io**, **Databricks**, **Fivetran**, or **Dataflow**.
	+ Data cataloging/governance tools (e.g., **Collibra**).
	+ CI/CD tools, Git workflows, and infrastructure automation.
	+ Real\-time/event\-driven data processing using **Pub/Sub**, **Kafka**, or similar platforms.
* Strategic problem\-solving skills and ability to architect innovative solutions.
* Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and lead adoption across teams.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to influence cross\-functional teams.
* Good experience on Agile Methodologies like Scrum, Kanban, and managing IT backlog.
* Be a “go\-to” expert for data technologies and solutions.

13\. Ability to identify and resolve security vulnerabilities in application code and infrastructure

jobs.description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
**Objectives of the Role**
* Lead U.S. healthcare products by defining the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities, ensuring alignment with payer, provider, and member needs.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to analyze requirements and translate them into strategic product initiatives.
* Partner with business teams and product managers to own and maintain the product backlog, prioritizing features based on business value and ROI.
* Stay current on healthcare industry trends, regulatory changes, and agile best practices to continuously evolve product strategy.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Requirement Gathering: Engage with product managers, customers, and client implementation teams to capture and refine business needs.
* Product Customization: Tailor healthcare product capabilities to meet client specifications while ensuring scalability and compliance.
* Regulatory Compliance: Guarantee adherence to HIPAA guidelines and other healthcare regulations during product design and implementation.
* Provider Network Expertise: Apply deep knowledge of provider networks to recommend best practices for onboarding new facilities/providers and optimizing network adequacy.
* Member Engagement: Design and implement initiatives that enhance member interaction and satisfaction with healthcare products.
* Agile Leadership: Actively lead agile ceremonies (PI Planning, Grooming, Refinement, Daily Scrum, Retrospectives) in partnership with the Scrum Master and team.
* Backlog Health: Ensure a well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and prioritization aligned to product strategy.
* Feature Definition: Develop detailed product specifications and communicate them effectively to development and QA teams.
* Value Delivery: Assess business value, create cases, and prioritize epics, stories, and themes to maximize impact.
* Release Management: Drive product release planning, set delivery expectations, and ensure timely rollout of new functionalities.
* Product Mindset: Serve as a product ambassador internally and externally, sharing domain expertise and addressing stakeholder questions.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Strong knowledge of U.S. healthcare domain, including members, providers, networks, claims, payments, EDI transactions, and HIPAA compliance.
* Proven ability to manage dynamic healthcare products that evolve through continuous refinements and member feedback.
* In‑depth expertise in product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe).
* 8\+ years of experience in product development or ownership.
* Experience in collaborating with diverse technical development and QA teams.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and leadership skills.
* Skilled at balancing and managing conflicting stakeholder priorities.
* Hands‑on experience with tools such as Confluence, Jira, Rally, and AI‑driven product management solutions.


**Preferred Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in healthcare, technology, or related discipline.
* Proficiency with modern product management tools and technologies.
* SAFe POPM certification (or equivalent).
* U.S. healthcare certifications in provider networks, claims, or compliance.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to you…

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.  

  

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences, and continuously improve service quality. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI\-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.  

  

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join the Network Control Center (NCC), Amazon's central incident management function for Customer Service. The NCC detects, manages, and resolves high\-severity incidents impacting customers, associates, drivers, and brands in real time — coordinating response across dozens of teams to minimize customer impact and restore service. When systems fail at scale, contact volumes spike unexpectedly, or a service disruption threatens millions of customer interactions, the NCC takes command. You will be responsible to be the single source of truth in terms of data and analysis during and after incidents, and ensure metrics at leadership level is reported accurately.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Real\-Time Incident Analytics — Serve as the single source of truth for data and analysis during high\-severity incidents, providing actionable insights to guide response decisions and minimize customer impact.

  

* Post\-Incident Reporting \& Metrics — Deliver accurate, leadership\-level metrics and post\-incident analysis, ensuring root causes, impact scope, and resolution timelines are clearly documented.

  

* Cross\-Functional Data Coordination — Partner with dozens of response teams during incidents to aggregate, validate, and synthesize data from multiple systems, enabling a unified operational picture.

  

* Trend Identification \& Proactive Insights — Analyze incident patterns, contact volume spikes, and service disruption data to identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures that reduce future customer impact.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2\+ years of complex Excel VBA macros writing experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with SQL or ETL

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with Tableau
* Experience using very large datasets

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Senior Analyst/Lead Analyst – Fundamental Equities (Privates) - Financial Research
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for a resourceful candidate to join our Financial Research group based in India. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad or, Bengaluru offices in India. The candidates preferring Hyderabad location would be required to start in the Bengaluru office and spend up to 6 months in the Bengaluru office. The role is a part of our Fundamental Equities (Privates) team, which collaborates closely with front office groups providing high\-quality, in\-depth research and analysis, supporting investment strategies and decision\-making processes.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:**
 In this role, you will partner with deal team members on portfolio monitoring and reporting, with approximately 80% of your time focused on portfolio monitoring and the remaining 20% dedicated to due diligence on new investment opportunities. You will support monitoring of portfolio companies across the investment lifecycle by collecting, organizing, and reviewing monthly and quarterly financial and operational updates. You will coordinate with the Pricing team on mark\-to\-market of portfolio positions, track portfolio performance metrics, and contribute to periodic portfolio reviews and internal management reporting. You will also work with the Investor Relations team to prepare data for periodic Limited Partner (LP) updates and assist with ad\-hoc LP information requests, and maintain monthly and quarterly dashboards covering capital deployment, MTM, portfolio performance, and exit scenarios, ensuring accurate, timely, and consistently formatted data. You will also conduct financial and commercial due diligence on new investment targets from Series A to pre\-IPO stages, analyzing unit economics, customer cohorts, and total addressable market, building financial models, reviewing data rooms, and preparing investment memos and presentations.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
 The ideal candidate should hold\-
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A degree in finance or equivalent, with 2 to 5 years of experience in portfolio management, monitoring, and reporting on private investments
* Demonstrated financial modelling and valuation skills
* Keen analytical skills and attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Prior experience in Big 4 Transaction Services, private equity or venture capital, or FP\&A roles


 Interested candidates can apply through our website:
   

  

 https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrLdAnaFEPvtJune26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

* DocuSign CLM Implementation Consultant (Proctored exam).

We are seeking a highly motivated professional to join the Product Control team, supporting Independent Price Verification (IPV), valuation governance, and regulatory control functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for validating the fair value of financial instruments, performing pricing analysis, investigating valuation discrepancies, and supporting the firm's control and compliance framework. This role requires strong analytical skills, market knowledge, and the ability to collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, Finance, and external pricing vendors


**Primary Job Responsibilities:**

* Perform detailed Independent Price Verification (IPV) validation and re\-pricing of securities to ensure the accuracy and integrity of valuations.
* Prepare, review, and validate daily, monthly, and periodic IPV reports for assigned products or business areas.
* Prepare and analyze various back\-testing reports, valuation analyses, and management reports to assess pricing trends and exceptions.
* Support Product Control activities by verifying market rates, closing prices, and identifying and investigating off\-market price movements.
* Utilize market data and analytical platforms such as Bloomberg, Intex, and Reuters to perform valuation and verification analysis.
* Co\-ordinate with Front Office, Middle Office, Product Control, and CMA teams, as well as external pricing vendors, to investigate and resolve pricing discrepancies and valuation variances.
* Assist in Sarbanes\-Oxley (SOX) control execution, coordination, testing, and documentation to support regulatory and audit requirements.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives, ad\-hoc analyses, and special projects as assigned by management.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Co\-ordinate with Front Office, Middle Office, Risk Management, Finance, and Product Control teams to resolve valuation issues.
* Liaise with external pricing vendors and market data providers to investigate pricing variances.
* Support valuation committees by providing analysis and commentary on material valuation exposures and exceptions.

**Controls, Audit \& Compliance**

* Support Sarbanes\-Oxley (SOX) controls, testing activities, and documentation requirements.
* Assist with internal and external audits by providing valuation evidence, supporting documentation, and control narratives.
* Ensure adherence to internal policies, governance standards, and regulatory requirements

**Process Improvement \& Projects**

* Identify opportunities to enhance valuation methodologies, controls, and reporting processes.
* Participate in automation and transformation initiatives aimed at improving operational efficiency.
* Support strategic projects and ad\-hoc assignments as directed by management.

**Qualifications:**

* MBA/CA or Equivalent Accounting Degree with 10\-12 years of progressive experience and atleast 7\-8 years of core experience in Valuation and IPV
* Securities knowledge preferred
* Bloomberg experience preferred
* Strong analytical and excel skills required
* Good communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.

**Skills to be Developed:**

* Understanding of State Street’s businesses, products and financial systems
* Analytical and problem solving skills
* Meeting preparation and presentation skills
* Development of global perspective and interaction with diverse cultures

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you ever struggle to explain your work? How's this: "Do you shop at Amazon? Do you know that box that says 'Add to Cart' and shows a price? Our team owns the model which picks that offer and the customer experience around the display of the offer price and the elements surrounding the 'Add to Cart' button which inform a purchase decision. We pick and display offers several billion times a day across all surfaces (mobile app, mobile web, desktop, Alexa shopping) worldwide." The mission of the Amazon Offers Experience organization is to be the world’s first and most trusted choice for every customer on earth to discover and evaluate any product or service.  

  

Our team blends machine learning models to rank and select the best offer from the most trusted merchant for all products sold on Amazon along with a world\-class front\-end user experience for offer comparison to our global customers. We are responsible for the experiences and services that enable developers, including our own, to create tailored shopping experiences for every customer, product, business and marketplace offered by Amazon. We build scalable and extensible frameworks which allow for many teams at Amazon to innovate within the Offers Experience in a federated manner. If you are passionate about influencing and delivering the next\-generation Amazon customer buying experience, we want to meet you.  

  

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager \- Tech to join one of the most impactful and visible teams in Amazon. In this role you will work with business stakeholders throughout Amazon and provide technical direction and business expertise to strategize and help launch new businesses and features for our customers. You will use data to justify customer friendly decisions and present customer and financial impact of the changes we make to our stakeholders. You will work closely with engineers, peer product managers, applied scientists, TPMs, managers, and senior leadership team to understand and drive business impact. Successful candidates will have experience working on multiple projects with different stakeholders, make data driven decisions, have strong communication skills to interact with executives, non\-technical and technical individuals and have a high technical bar along with a passion for people and project management. This is an opportunity to work with a team that drives one of the most coveted real estate in the E\-commerce, the Amazon ‘Buy Box’ on Amazon Product Detail Page, Amazon Search Page , multiple buying widgets etc. on the Amazon desktop, mobile and tablet environments.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Today, millions of third party sellers offer products alongside Amazon Retail though the Amazon Marketplace and compete to be featured on the ‘Add to Cart’ button (aka the ‘Buy Box’) on Amazon’s most valuable retail real estate – the Product Detail Page referenced above. The Featured Merchant Algorithm (FMA) teams owns the Tier – I systems and Machine Learning algorithms that selects the offer to be featured on the Buy Box and on Amazon Search Pages. The team’s mission is to ensure that the featured offer provides the best possible customer value based on factors including price, availability, delivery options and customer service. The Amazon ‘Buy Box’ is arguably the most valued real estate in the E\-commerce world and we are looking for strong leaders to continue innovating for this customer facing functionality. We are looking for a Principal Product Manager – Tech to join one of the most impactful and visible teams in Amazon. In this role you will work with business stakeholders throughout Amazon and provide technical direction and business expertise to strategize and help launch new businesses and features for our customers. You will use data to justify customer friendly decisions and present customer and financial impact of the changes we make to our stakeholders. You will work closely with engineers, peer product managers, applied scientists, TPMs, managers, and senior leadership team to understand and drive business impact.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience technical product management

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Maintenance\-as\-a\-Service business, a new vertical that extends SSE’s home\-energy platform to non\-SSE
 



 customers. This is a hands\-on, end\-to\-end ownership role in an early\-stage, high\-ambiguity context,
 



 where the product charter is still being defined and the business model is still being proven.
 



 You will work closely with the MaaS business lead, engineering, design, and field operations to shape
 



 how the product works \- from the customer acquisition and onboarding flow through service delivery,
 



 scheduling, billing, and ongoing engagement. The role requires both sharp product thinking and genuine
 



 comfort operating in an environment where the playbook doesn’t yet exist.
 



 Scope \& Ownership
 



 ● Own the MaaS product end\-to\-end \- from customer discovery and onboarding through service
 



 scheduling, delivery, billing, and renewal. This is a zero\-to\-one charter.
 



 ● Build the product capability that enables SSE to serve non\-SSE solar customers reliably at scale \-
 



 including customer identity and plant onboarding, eligibility and plan selection, AMC service
 



 scheduling and visit management, billing/ payment flows, and customer\-facing communication.
 



 ● Own the integration between MaaS and the broader SSE platform \- specifically how MaaS
 



 customers are represented in internal SSE systems without creating bespoke systems that
 



 fragment the platform.
 



 ● Drive product discovery through close engagement with MaaS customers, field service teams,
 



 and business stakeholders.
 



 ● Define success metrics, track adoption and business outcomes, and iterate post\-launch with a
 



 bias toward closing what doesn’t work.
 



 ● Identify and address recurring inefficiencies, rework, and escalations across the MaaS customer
 



 journey through better product and system design.
 



 ● Partner with engineering and design to balance near\-term delivery with foundational work
 



 required to scale the MaaS business reliably.
 



 What Success Requires
 



 ● 4–6 years of product management experience, ideally in consumer\-facing or service\-delivery
 



 contexts where the customer journey spans digital and physical touchpoints \- home services,
 



 mobility, logistics, healthcare, or similar.
 



 ● Proven track record of owning a product problem end\-to\-end \- from discovery and definition
 



 through execution, measurement, and iteration.
 



 ● Comfort operating in early\-stage, low\-structure environments \- able to derive problem
 



 understanding from direct observation, stakeholder conversations, and data rather than waiting
 



 for documentation to exist.
 



 ● Strong analytical instinct \- uses data to inform prioritization and decisions, and can reason from
 



 first principles about what metrics actually reflect product and business health.
 



 ● Field operator design instinct is a meaningful plus \- the MaaS service delivery layer involves
 



 ground teams and non\-desk users. Candidates with experience designing for field\-force or
 



 service\-delivery contexts are preferred.
 



 ● Understanding of subscription, renewal, and service\-contract business models \- how customers
 



 make plan decisions, what drives retention, and how pricing and product interact.
 



 ● Ability to work across a cross\-functional team including a business owner, engineering, design,
 



 and operations \- driving alignment and execution without positional authority.
 



 ● Clear, structured written communication \- able to translate ambiguous business problems into
 



 precise product requirements and make trade\-offs legible to technical and non\-technical
 



 stakeholders alike

jobs.title: Product-led Growth Manager
jobs.description:
**About Hevo** 




 Hevo is a simple, no\-code data pipeline platform that helps companies unify and prepare their data for analytics and AI. Hevo enables 2,500\+ data\-driven companies, including DoorDash, Shopify, Postman, and Groww, to get their data AI\-ready by automating complex integration and transformation tasks across hundreds of sources.
 



 By removing engineering bottlenecks, Hevo allows teams to focus on what actually matters: generating insights, building intelligent products, and making faster decisions.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




 You own the moment a data practitioner signs up for Hevo through the moment they become a paying customer, and everything in between. That means the trial experience, the lifecycle touchpoints, the activation metrics, and the conversion plays. You will work across Product, Growth, and Sales to make the self\-serve funnel a predictable revenue source.
 



 This is the connective tissue between the product and the pipeline. You are not a reporter of results. You are the person who defines what success looks like, instruments the funnel to measure it, and ships the interventions that move it.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




**1\. Trial Lifecycle and Activation** 



* Define what trial success looks like: set activation milestones, instrument the funnel, and report on conversion performance weekly
* Map the full trial journey from signup through first pipeline to the aha moment and conversion, identifying every point where intent drops
* Build dashboards connecting trial activation to conversion to ARR influence
* Design and run lifecycle communications: onboarding email sequences, in\-app nudges, and re\-engagement flows tied to behavioral triggers
* Act as the internal voice of the trial user in Product, GTM, and leadership conversations



**2\. Conversion Rate Optimization** 



* Synthesize behavioral data (session recordings, funnel drop\-off, in\-app event data) into structured conversion hypotheses with clear success metrics
* Design and execute Conversion Rate Optimization across onboarding flows, signup pages, and trial touchpoints with documented methodology and learnings
* Partner with Design on landing page variants for high\-intent entry points such as use\-case pages, competitor comparison pages, and ICP\-segment pages. You define the hypothesis and copy; Design executes
* Maintain a rigorous experiment log: hypothesis, variant rationale, statistical methodology, results, and learnings. Every test is a learning asset



**3\. Product and GTM Partnership** 



* Surface structured, prioritized insights from trial users into the roadmap process weekly
* Build technically credible trial\-stage collateral: setup walkthroughs, migration guides, competitive comparison assets written for data practitioners, not buyers
* Create and maintain a weekly product to GTM feedback brief synthesizing signals from trials, support tickets, deal reviews, and customer conversations
* Support competitive displacement motions with proof\-of\-concept content and trial\-stage enablement assets



  





**What You Need to Bring** 




**Non\-Negotiable** 



* 4–7 years across Product Marketing, Growth, or PLG at a B2B SaaS company with direct ownership of a trial or self\-serve conversion program and measurable outcomes
* Hands\-on data background: you have worked as or closely alongside a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Data Scientist, and can write for that audience without translation
* Strong understanding of PLG mechanics: activation frameworks, aha\-moment design, in\-product lifecycle marketing, and trial funnel instrumentation
* Behavioral analytics skills: Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog for funnel and activation tracking; Hotjar or FullStory for session analysis
* Experimentation discipline: you have designed and run A/B tests with proper statistical methodology, not just changed the button color
* Lifecycle marketing execution: you have built email sequences or in\-app messaging tied to behavioral triggers, not just calendars
* Clear technical writing: you can produce a migration guide and a conversion hypothesis in the same week



**Strong Advantage** 



* Familiarity with PLG tools: in\-app messaging (Appcues, Pendo, or equivalent), lifecycle email (Customer.io, Braze), and interactive demos (Arcade, Navattic, Storylane)
* Experience with competitive displacement at the trial stage, building proof\-of\-concept content that moves a Fivetran or Airbyte user toward a switch decision
* Basic HTML/CSS comfort to push copy changes or CTA edits without filing a ticket
