jobs.description:
Syndigo powers the continual flow of data and content throughout the entire commerce ecosystem— accelerating delivery of accurate and compelling information that increases sales on every shelf. We are the recognized leader in software and services for the management of master data, product information, digital assets, and content syndication and analytics across industries including grocery, foodservice, hardlines, home improvement, oil \& gas, pet, health and beauty, automotive, apparel, and healthcare products.
 



 Syndigo serves the industry’s largest two\-sided network, connecting more than 50,000 global users across 12,000\+ global brands with more than 1,750 global retailers.
 



 Basically, we're the people that deliver the rich, accurate product content that helps consumers shop online with confidence, and helps brands and retailers operate efficient product supply chains. We cannot do all of this without our amazing employees who make the magic happen here at Syndigo. As we continue to grow, we’re always looking to identify talented individuals to join our team.
 



  
 



**Product Manager** 





**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location\*\*** 





 We are looking for a Product Manager who embraces an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), using AI throughout the product lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and deliver measurable customer outcomes. You will use AIDLC to lead the strategy and execution of capabilities across our Product Experience Management (PXM) platform while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and enhance customer productivity at scale.
 



**HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY** 



* Define functional and non\-functional requirements and recommend solutions in the form of POCs, prototypes, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to groom stories and iterate on prototypes throughout the release cycle.
* Act as a proxy for the business throughout development, testing, and release activities to ensure business needs are met.
* Develop business analysis artifacts, such as business rules and process flows, to clarify requirements.
* Coordinate with other departments in advance of feature and product launches to develop messaging that supports and promotes new releases, features, and updates.
* Conduct product training internally and externally, including training internal trainers, developing new product and feature documentation, and introducing new functionality to internal employees and key customers.
* Provide consistency and clarity to development projects by identifying business needs and constraints, defining scope, and ensuring efficient execution.
* Design product processes that move initiatives forward using AI tooling.
* Advance the use of AI and autonomous agents to transform and accelerate the product development lifecycle.



**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU** 



* 4–5 years of Product Management experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS products.
* Proven experience operating within an AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), leveraging AI across discovery, requirements, design, delivery, and product optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of defining, launching, and scaling AI\-powered features, agents, automation workflows, or intelligent recommendation systems.
* Hands\-on experience using Generative AI and LLM\-based tools to accelerate product management workflows, improve decision\-making, and increase team productivity.
* Strong understanding of AI product patterns, including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Ability to identify high\-value automation opportunities and translate them into measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Data\-driven mindset with experience defining success metrics, evaluating AI outcomes, and driving continuous product improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, implementation\-ready product requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead cross\-functional teams without formal authority.
* Experience in PIM, PXM, DAM, Syndication, eCommerce, Retail, CPG, Manufacturing, or Distribution domains (preferred but not required).



  
 


**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion** 

 To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.
 



 Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful! 
 



 All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

 At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** 
 Product Manager / Product Manager \- II
 



**Experience Required:** 
 3\-5 years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, KR
 



  





**The Role** 




 We're hiring Product Managers to own product lines within our LOS platform — end to end. You'll gather requirements directly with credit union clients, write stories, run sprints with your engineering pod, coordinate vendor integrations, and ship features that go live for real users.
 



 Beyond product lines, you'll own client implementations. Each PM on the team takes a credit union implementation end to end — from requirement gathering through go\-live. We rotate implementations across the team so everyone builds the muscle of running a full client delivery, not just a feature backlog.
 



 You'll also contribute to the overall platform roadmap — identifying patterns across client implementations, surfacing what should be configurable vs. custom, and shaping the product into something that scales beyond any single client.
 



 This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You won't be writing strategy decks. You'll be in the details — on client calls understanding how an underwriter makes decisions, in vendor docs figuring out an API spec, in sprint planning making scope tradeoffs with your engineers.
 



  





**A typical week looks like** 



* 2\-3 client calls with US credit union stakeholders — CXOs, managers, underwriters,
* Act as the bridge between US team \& India Engineering team
* Writing PRFAQs, stories and acceptance criteria for upcoming work
* Sprint ceremonies with your engineering pod — planning, grooming, retro
* Coordinating with 2\-3 vendor integration teams — API specs, test data, certification
* Ensuring alignment across organisation for delivery for your product line \& client implementation



  





**What you'll ship in the first 6 months** 



* Own a product line end\-to\-end
* Own a client implementation from requirements through go\-live
* Ship features that go live in production for real credit union users
* Manage 3\-5 vendor integrations through to QA sign\-off
* Run your pod's sprint cycle independently
* Contribute at least one platform\-level improvement that benefits all clients



  





**What we're looking for** 



* Biased for action, grounded in first principles — you ship fast, but you think before you build.
* AI\-native — you use AI tools daily to multiply your output, not as a novelty. You write specs faster, research deeper, and make better decisions because AI is part of how you work.
* Comfortable working directly with clients (US business hours overlap required — expect 2\-3 late evening calls per week)
* Writes clearly — PRFAQs, story documents, acceptance criteria
* Can own an engineering pod's backlog — sprint planning, grooming, prioritization
* Understands lending workflows — origination, decisioning, underwriting, funding
* Can navigate vendor integrations — read API docs, coordinate with external teams, unblock engineers
* Uses data and judgment to make scope calls fast — you won't have perfect information

**Qualifications** 




**Required:** 



* 3\-5 years total experience with at least 2 years in product management
* Lending, banking, or fintech domain experience
* Experience working with engineering teams in an agile environment
* Actively uses AI tools in daily PM work — research, writing, analysis, decision\-making
* Familiar with Claude Code to leverage AI \& work at 10x productivity
* BTech/BE. MBA preferred.

* **Familiar with Claude Code to leverage AI \& work at 10x productivity**

* US indirect auto lending (dealer\-lender workflows, RouteOne, DealerTrack)

 State Street

* Integrated close and intercompany.
* Revenue accounting
* Expense accounting

jobs.description:
**Join our India Tech Hub – Be among the first hires!**
 Kobie, a 35\-year veteran of the loyalty industry, a multi\-year Forrester Leader, and USA Top Workplace is expanding its global footprint by establishing a Tech Hub in India. Kobie partners with global brands to build deep connections with their customers through personalized, data\-driven loyalty experiences and has a mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty. The Tech Hub will serve as a Global Capabilities Center for a broad range of technology roles, and this is your chance to play a pivotal role in shaping our presence in India. Join us as we continue to lead in loyalty, delivering innovative customer experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands while working alongside some of the best and brightest in loyalty.
   

  

**About The Team And What We’ll Build Together**
 The Product Owner team makes Kobie's strategic product vision a reality through the development of technology solutions. We drive projects forward, collaborating with development teams and stakeholders to deliver unparalleled personalized experiences to customers worldwide. We are quick on our feet, using critical thinking and creative problem solving to optimize the value of products released. We champion platform standards to achieve long\-lasting, quality outcomes that help our clients grow enterprise value through loyalty.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
* Lead design and execution of roadmap enhancements to Kobie Alchemy® Loyalty Cloud, owning the business logic and platform rules that drive loyalty program outcomes for enterprise clients.
* Translate complex business requirements into precise, unambiguous specifications that serve as the authoritative source of truth for automated and AI\-assisted development workflows, while ensuring maximize reusability across clients and verticals.
* Manage the product backlog including dependencies, priority, sequence, strategy, and business objectives.
* Identify and address challenges that arise during the product development lifecycle, collaborating with team members to find creative solutions and keep development on track.
* Provide mechanisms for teams and stakeholders to view and track team and product work progress across releases and major product milestones.
* Share vision and purpose for all product development efforts, gaining interest and buy\-in from various audiences, including business and technical roles at multiple levels of the organization.
* Owns and evolve the business logic governing your domains of expertise, serving as the voice of reason on what the platform should do and why, influencing technical and business decisions alike.


**What You Need To Be Successful**
* 5\+ years working in a Product Owner, Business Systems Analyst, Product Manager, or similar role
* Demonstrated experience driving Agile/Scrum delivery projects involving web\-based software, API and batch integrations, and real\-time event\-driven systems, with comfort operating in or transitioning toward spec\-driven and AI\-assisted SDLC environments
* Exceptional ability to reason through complex business logic, identify edge cases, and produce precise written specifications, paired with strong technical foundation and a knack for translating concepts into language business and tech roles can understand
* Loyalty product, program, or industry experience strongly preferred; familiarity with accounting ledger concepts, real\-time decisioning systems, or rules engines is a plus
* Familiarity with UX research and best practices a plus
* PMI\-PBA/CBAP/CSPO/PSPO certification a plus
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience


**About Kobie**
 Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals ready to join a collaborative, growth\-focused culture.
   

  

 As a trusted partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are loyalty leaders, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.  We do this with a strategy\-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level.As we launch our India Tech Hub, we are excited to bring our award\-winning culture to a new region \- creating an environment where collaboration, flexibility, and career growth come together to build something truly special.
   

  

 We are proud to be the only loyalty provider to be externally recognized for their culture. We believe people thrive when they feel valued, supported, and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion ensures every teammate has a voice and the opportunity to be heard.
   

  

 Giving back is in our DNA at Kobie,through an annual fundraiser, charitable partnerships, and volunteer opportunities, we encourage our teammates to make a difference in their communities.
   

  

 To support our teammates beyond just their careers, we offer highly competitive benefits, comprehensive health coverage, and well\-being perks that support our teammates and their dependents. We understand the importance of time for life outside of work \- recognizing public holidays,offering flexible time off, and prioritizing work\-life balance.
   

  

 As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U.S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. With continued growth, we will establish a physical office in Bengaluru, India, giving teammates aspace for collaboration and fostering connection.
   

  

 Now is the perfect time to join Kobie. Be part of something big and help shape the future of our global capabilities center, the Kobie India Tech Hub.

jobs.description:
**About Us:** 
 At Molecular Connections, we believe in "Connecting brilliant minds, for building the future of scientific intelligence. Founded more than two decades ago, Molecular Connections is the leading AI\-ML led data science organization accelerating digital transformation of Scientific Scholarly Publishing, STEM (science, technology, engineering and medical) and pharmaceutical data science/information/analytics domains, globally. Our marquee customer base is spread across US, UK, Europe and other geographies. Headquartered in Bengaluru, our technology and customer delivery centers are based across various tier 1 and tier 2 cities across south India. We are growing strongly both organically and inorganically with our latest technology\-driven acquisitions in Germany and UK..
 



 For more info please visit: https://career.molecularconnections.com/job\-openings/
 



  





**Role:
 
 Product Owner – Peer Review \& Publishing Systems**




 We are seeking a detail\-oriented Product Owner – Peer Review \& Publishing Systems to lead the tactical execution and software delivery of our enterprise peer review platform. Working alongside domain experts who set the strategic vision, you will serve as the central functional authority for the engineering team—mapping out complex manuscript decision trees, defining role\-based access rules, and managing sprint backlogs.
 



  





 Your core mission is to convert high\-level product requirements into crystal\-clear user stories, workflow diagrams, and acceptance criteria. You will ensure that our platform reaches feature\-and\-scale parity with market benchmarks like ScholarOne Manuscripts and Editorial Manager, delivering a rock\-solid system for global journal publishers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Backlog Ownership \& Sprint Execution**



* **Backlog Management:** 
 Build, groom, and prioritize the product backlog in Jira/Azure DevOps, ensuring user stories are fully defined and ready for development.
* **Agile Rituals:** 
 Lead daily standups, backlog refinement sessions, sprint planning, and sprint reviews/demos with engineering, QA, and UI/UX teams.
* **Acceptance \& QA:** 
 Write explicit acceptance criteria (Gherkin/BDD format preferred) and conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to sign off on feature releases before production deployment.



  





**Workflow Architecture \& Decision Tree Mapping**



* **Editorial Workflows:** 
 Map out intricate manuscript decision trees for various review models (single\-blind, double\-blind, triple\-blind, open, and transparent review).
* **State Engines \& Permissions:** 
 Define granular status transitions, automated notifications, role\-based access controls (Author, Editor, Reviewer, Publisher, Admin), and override permissions.
* **System Edge Cases:** 
 Anticipate and resolve operational friction points—such as multi\-submission edge cases, reviewer conflict\-of\-interest triggers, revised manuscript handling, and co\-author verification flows.



  





**Functional Specifications for Industry Integrations**



* Define precise technical specifications and user flows for integrating core scholarly publishing standards:
* **Persistent Identifiers:** 
 ORCID authentication, ROR (Research Organization Registry), Ringgold.
* **Integrity Tools:** 
 iThenticate/Turnitin similarity checks, AI\-content detection reports, image manipulation analysis.
* **Standards \& Exports:** 
 JATS XML payload generation, MECA (Manuscript Exchange with Single Sign\-On) protocol compliance.
* **Financial \& Production:** 
 APC (Article Processing Charge) payment triggers, fee waiver logic, and post\-acceptance production package handoffs



  





**Developer \& Technical Guidance**



* Act as the direct, day\-to\-day liaison for developers, clarifying functional edge cases and resolving ambiguities during active sprints.
* Translate non\-technical requirements from editorial SMEs into structured technical user stories, wireframe concepts, and data mapping inputs.
* Partner with technical architects to balance functional scope with system performance, scalability, and technical debt management



  





**Required Skills \& Competencies:** 



* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:** 
 4 to 7 years of professional experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst, with at least
 **4\+ years focused directly on scholarly publishing, STM editorial systems, or complex enterprise SaaS engines** 
 .
* **Agile Proficiency:** 
 Deep hands\-on experience running Agile/Scrum teams using Jira, Confluence, or similar project management tools (CSPO or PSPO certification is a plus).



  





**Technical \& Domain Competencies**



* Proven ability to draw complex workflow diagrams, state machine transitions, and system flowcharts using tools like Lucidchart, Miro, or Visio.
* Clear understanding of the manuscript lifecycle—from submission triage, reviewer selection/invitation, and decision letters to author revisions and final production export.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON/XML payload structures, and database entities related to editorial workflows.



  





**Core Mindset**





     
 



* Obsessive attention to detail when mapping out system logic, business rules, and user interaction states.
* Excellent communication skills to bridge the gap between business objectives and technical implementation details.



  





**Why Join Molecular Connections?** 



* This is a unique opportunity to join a mission\-driven company at a pivotal time in its growth in
 **building the next\-generation scientific intelligence platform**

jobs.title: Product Owner – Enterprise Applications
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
 As the Product Owner for Enterprise Applications (ARAS), you will serve as the bridge between business strategy and technical execution within our PLM ecosystem. You are responsible for defining the platform vision, roadmap, and delivery priorities to drive operational efficiency and system scalability. A key component of this role is maintaining a continuous feedback loop with subject matter experts to ensure that ARAS configurations accurately mirror complex business processes and deliver high\-value digital solutions.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
* Strategy \& Roadmap: Direct the development and maintenance of the ARAS module roadmap, ensuring it supports enterprise scalability.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Act as the primary liaison between Engineering, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, and Digital Technology teams to ensure cohesive cross\-functional outcomes.
* Requirement Management: Lead the discovery and formalization of business requirements, ensuring solutions are well\-defined and validated before execution.
* Value Driven Solution Design: Analyze system functionality to design, develop, and implement value\-added, cost\-optimized PLM enhancements.
* Backlog Ownership: Manage the product backlog, including the creation of detailed user stories and the definition of clear acceptance criteria for the development team.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Manage end\-to\-end testing processes, including test planning, execution, and defect resolution.
* Support \& Documentation: Provide ongoing support for system issues, curate knowledge management content, and design effective training collateral.


**Required Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline
* Experience: 12\+ years of progressive experience in Business Process Analysis, PLM Product Management, or a comparable role within a complex engineering and manufacturing environment.
* Technical Expertise: Extensive hands\-on experience and proven implementation success with the ARAS PLM platform.
* Domain Knowledge: Functional and implementation expertise in Part Management, Product Management, Program \& Portfolio Management, CAD Management, Change Management, Configuration Management, BoM Management, and ERP integrations (SAP/Oracle etc.,).


**Desired Characteristics**
* Communication: Exceptional analytical, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* Problem\-Solving: Decisive in addressing complex issues and driving systemic improvements.
* Leadership: Experience leading large\-scale programs in global, matrixed environments with a focus on training others.

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Caterpillar is seeking a well‑qualified
 **D365 Product Owner – Retail \& Commerce** 
 , responsible for supporting the full functional needs of the Caterpillar Enterprise Resource Platform (ERP) template for Caterpillar Dealers. The Caterpillar ERP solution will be built on
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations** 
 , with specialization in
 **Retail \& Commerce** 
 and preferred knowledge in
 **Finance**

jobs.description:
At **KeyData Cyber,** we're shaping the future of identity security. Recognized by Gartner and KuppingerCole as a leading IAM professional services firm, we specialize exclusively in designing, deploying, and managing end\-to\-end Identity and Access Management programs for organizations across North America.

We deliver comprehensive solutions across IAM domains, including:

If you're ready to grow your career alongside some of the industry's best, come join us — you're key to our success

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, Remote

* Partner with business and application owners to gather, analyze, and document existing access request workflows.

* Offer day\-to\-day project support and actively participate in project meetings and discussions.

* Provide inputs, options, and recommendations to the IAM leadership team to support decision\-making.
* Assist in generating project\-specific reports and documentation as required.

--------------------------

 Data Analytics \& Reporting

* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring patient complaints and service gaps.
* Support implementation of patient experience improvement initiatives across clinical and non\-clinical departments.
* Measure the effectiveness of interventions through data\-driven insights.

 Dashboard \& KPI Management

* Net Promoter Score (NPS)
* Patient Satisfaction Score (PSS)
* Complaint Resolution TAT
* OPD/IPD Patient Experience Scores
* Discharge Experience
* Billing Experience
* Waiting Time
* Service Recovery Effectiveness
* Online Reputation Ratings



  





 Strategic Projects

 Stakeholder Management

jobs.title: Business Analyst, VP
jobs.description:
Join us as a Business Analyst
   

  

* This is an opportunity for a driven Business Analyst to join us and make a tangible impact on our function
* You’ll be producing business requirements to inform future state design, as you support teams to understand and link the requirements to the overall domain strategy
* It’s a chance to develop your skills as you research, understand and keep up to date with industry thinking, best practice, technology and customer trends
* We're offering this role at vice president level


 What you'll do
   

  

 As a Business Analyst, you’ll understand our business, customers, strategic goals and how the teams operate in order to support the realisation of the desired outcome by the team. You’ll be working in continuous close collaboration with the business and the feature team, making sure that the vision and requirements are transparent.
   

  

 We’ll look to you to work across teams and stakeholders to capture, validate and document business and system requirements, making sure they are in line with key strategic principles, and translated from business operations, business objectives, or from external requirements.
   

  

**You’ll Also Be**
* Interacting with customers, key stakeholders and the team to obtain and document functional and non\-functional needs
* Supporting the team to analyse business requirements and technical specifications to see how they can be developed into small testable and releasable elements
* Supporting the feature team in creating and executing test scenarios and test scripts, identifying and supporting cut\-over and implementation tasks
* Facilitating UAT as well as supporting platform and feature teams in executing the UAT
* Supporting innovation by contributing to the design of high quality solutions which focus on providing demonstrable value to the business in a regular and timely manner


 The skills you'll need
   

  

 To take on this role, you’ll need an appropriate business analyst certification, alongside a good understanding of Agile values, principles and methodologies with experience of working within an Agile environment. The role acts as a bridge between Business, Operations, Technology, Architecture, and Testing teams to ensure payment solutions meet regulatory, operational, and customer requirements
   

  

**You’ll Also Need**
* Proven application of business analysis tools and techniques
* Experience in analyzing, documenting, and managing business requirements for SEPA and ISO 20022 payment transformation initiatives
* Strong knowledge of payment processing, SEPA schemes, ISO 20022 standards, business analysis methodologies, and project delivery within a banking or financial services environment
